method: The referenced ImageGen sheet and a localized generated detail were assembled. The detail-edit record identifies their hashes and placement.
request:
Edit the first input image, the selected storyboard. Preserve the existing four landscape panel positions in a 2×2 grid, exact original numbered SHOT_ badges, original palette/compositions and actor likeness. The second input is original family visual reference. Dan blue / left watch, Maya plum with ponytail, Nina teal auburn waves, Leo orange, braided Ella in denim overalls, small Max green. A third reference supplies setting or continuity. In every panel actors and props must follow its specified shot precisely. Keep good panels intact. Apply the following specific changes in the artwork. Use one continuous same waist-high potting bench, terracotta saucers and three terracotta pots arranged from camera LEFT to RIGHT mint plant, basil plant, bare radish soil. Each separate simple wooden stake stays in its own pot, legible natural short front-facing labels MINT, BASIL, RADISH. Only those three, never an extra planting bench. All participants wear fitted pale gardening gloves on both hands in all four shots; Leo writes wearing gloves. 049 examine trace of water glint in mint saucer; no pour. 050 central actor Dan carefully transfers from one green can into the single clear graduated measure held by Nina. Leo takes notes, dry other two saucers. 051 focus on gloved Nina pouring into exposed brown soil INSIDE center pot next to basil stem, to side of leaves; a slim stream clearly bypasses ALL basil leaves. Maya steadies the saucer while Ella keeps clear. 052 settle with little glint in basil saucer; both green plants upright, bare radish, no pour. Give each actor their established face, age, costume and hair, including Dan's mustache. Warm sunny daylight; copy the same prop shapes between all four frames.

detail_edit.detail_request: A precision continuity repair to this single close-up. Keep this exact crop and camera framing of the original artwork, the sleeve and garden gloves, MINT and BASIL wood stakes, saucers, fabric and fence. The transparent measure currently has its lip directly above the basil leaves. Move the lip to the RIGHT of the entire basil leaf canopy and clearly show a narrow unbroken water stream from the lip down into an OPEN crescent of bare brown soil directly INSIDE THE RIGHT RIM of the center basil pot. Move the foliage cluster left within this same pot to make generous room for the naked soil at the right edge; move the basil stake slightly left if necessary. The stream must be plainly visible against brown soil or background all the way down without touching a single green leaf. The glass graduation is a simple correct 100 mL; only 100 mL visible if needed. No extra pots, no pouring onto the saucer, labels all remain. Preserve original 3D stylized family film aesthetic, scene lighting and precise crop border so this is an invisible retouch.
